local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "Auto click PRO"

ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local function makeDraggable(frame, handle)
    handle = handle or frame

    local dragging = false
    local dragStart
    local startPos
    local activeInput

    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position
            activeInput = input

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                    activeInput = nil
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    local function updatePosition(input)
        if not dragging then return end

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            updatePosition(input)
        end
    end)

    UIS.TouchMoved:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and activeInput == input then
            updatePosition(input)
        end
    end)
end

    local myLook = myHRP.CFrame.LookVector
    local closest = nil
    local shortest = HitboxFrontDistance

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            if player.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local targetHRP = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                local dir = (targetHRP.Position - myHRP.Position)
                local dist = dir.Magnitude

                if dist <= HitboxFrontDistance then
                    local dot = myLook:Dot(dir.Unit)
                    if dot > 0.4 then 
                        if dist < shortest then
                            shortest = dist
                            closest = player
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

local function GetClosestPlayer(maxDist)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end

    local myPos = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    local closest = nil
    local shortest = maxDist

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            if player.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local dist = (player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                if dist < shortest then
                    shortest = dist
                    closest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or not char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then

            targetHRP.CanCollide = false

            myHRP.CFrame = targetHRP.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1)

    if HitboxFrontEnabled and iHaveBomb then

            end

            if hrp then

    end
end)

		textBox.Text = ""
	else
		setStatus("Purchase failed.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
	end
end

	refreshStars()

refreshStars()

local espObjects = {}

local function clearESP(plr)

local function updateESP(plr, isBeast)
    if plr == lp or not flags.Players then

    end

    local char = plr.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then
        return clearESP(plr)
    end

    local o = espObjects[plr]
    if o and (o.char ~= char or not o.hl.Parent or not o.bb.Parent) then
        clearESP(plr)
        o = nil

    if not o then
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(clearESP)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- COMPUTER + POD + DOOR ESP
-- (finds objects by exact name, like the old Rayfield script)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local objects = {} -- [instance] = {kind, hl, adornee}
local lastMapName, lastScan = nil, 0

local function kindOf(inst)
    local n = inst.Name
    if n == "ComputerTable" then return "COMPUTER" end
    if n == "FreezePod" then return "POD" end
    if n:lower() == "exitdoor" then return "EXIT" end
    if n == "SingleDoor" or n == "DoubleDoor" then return "DOOR" end
end

local function adorneeFor(inst)
    -- single doors highlight only the moving "Door" part, double doors the whole model
    if inst.Name == "SingleDoor" then
        return inst:FindFirstChild("Door")
    end
    return inst
end

local function wanted(kind)
    return (kind == "COMPUTER" and flags.Computers)
        or (kind == "POD" and flags.Pods)
        or (kind == "DOOR" and flags.Doors)
        or (kind == "EXIT" and flags.ExitDoors)
end

local function clearObj(inst)
    local o = objects[inst]
    if o then
        o.hl:Destroy()
        objects[inst] = nil
    end
end

local function scanObjects()
    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        local kind = kindOf(d)
        if kind and wanted(kind) and not objects[d] then
            local adornee = adorneeFor(d)
            if adornee then
                objects[d] = {kind = kind, hl = makeHighlight(adornee, "ObjESP"), adornee = adornee}
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Computer is "done" when its screen turns dark green
local function isHacked(model)
    local screen = model:FindFirstChild("Screen", true)
    return screen ~= nil and screen:IsA("BasePart")
        and screen.BrickColor == BrickColor.new("Dark green")
end

-- ActionSign value: 11 = open (green), 10 = closed (red)
local function doorColor(inst)
    local trigger = inst:FindFirstChild("DoorTrigger")
    local sign = trigger and trigger:FindFirstChild("ActionSign")
    local val = sign and sign.Value
    if val == 11 then return DOOR_OPEN end
    if val == 10 then return DOOR_CLOSED end
end

local function updateObjects()
    for inst, o in pairs(objects) do
        if not wanted(o.kind) then clearObj(inst) end
    end
    if not flags.Computers and not flags.Pods and not flags.Doors and not flags.ExitDoors then return end

    local mapName = rs("CurrentMap")
    local now = os.clock()
    if mapName ~= lastMapName or now - lastScan > 5 then
        lastMapName, lastScan = mapName, now
        scanObjects()
    end

    for inst, o in pairs(objects) do
        if not inst.Parent or not o.adornee.Parent or not o.hl.Parent then
            clearObj(inst)
        elseif o.kind == "COMPUTER" then
            setColor(o.hl, isHacked(inst) and COMPUTER_DONE or COMPUTER_COLOR)
        elseif o.kind == "POD" then
            setColor(o.hl, POD_COLOR)
        elseif o.kind == "EXIT" then
            setColor(o.hl, EXIT_COLOR)
        else
            local c = doorColor(inst)
            if c then setColor(o.hl, c) end
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BEAST ARROW (automatic while Players ESP is on)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local arrow = Instance.new("Frame")
arrow.Name = "BeastArrow"
arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60)
arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
arrow.Visible = false
arrow.Parent = gui

-- Arrow shape: thin shaft + a sharp triangular head (tip points up)
local HEAD_TIP_Y = 8        -- y of the very tip inside the arrow frame
local HEAD_HEIGHT = 22
local HEAD_SLOPE = 0.45     -- half-width gained per pixel down (bigger = fatter head)
local SHAFT_WIDTH = 6
local SHAFT_BOTTOM = 52
local OUTLINE = 2.5

local function rowFrame(y, width, height, color, z)
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, y)
    f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
    f.BackgroundColor3 = color
    f.BorderSizePixel = 0
    f.ZIndex = z
    f.Parent = arrow
    return f
end

-- Triangle from 1px rows (2px tall so rows overlap and leave no seams)
local function head(tipY, height, color, z)
    for i = 0, math.ceil(height) - 1 do
        rowFrame(tipY + i, 2 * HEAD_SLOPE * (i + 1), 2, color, z)
    end
end

local function shaft(topY, bottomY, width, color, z)
    local f = rowFrame(topY, width, bottomY - topY, color, z)
    Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(width / 2))
end

-- Black outline first (pushed out evenly on every side), then the red arrow on top
local sinHalf = HEAD_SLOPE / math.sqrt(1 + HEAD_SLOPE * HEAD_SLOPE)
local tipPush = OUTLINE / sinHalf
head(HEAD_TIP_Y - tipPush, HEAD_HEIGHT + tipPush + OUTLINE, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1)
shaft(HEAD_TIP_Y + HEAD_HEIGHT - 4, SHAFT_BOTTOM + OUTLINE, SHAFT_WIDTH + OUTLINE * 2, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1)

head(HEAD_TIP_Y, HEAD_HEIGHT, BEAST_COLOR, 2)
shaft(HEAD_TIP_Y + HEAD_HEIGHT - 4, SHAFT_BOTTOM, SHAFT_WIDTH, BEAST_COLOR, 2)

-- Distance readout next to the arrow
local distLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
distLabel.Name = "BeastDistance"
distLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
distLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 20)
distLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
distLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
distLabel.TextSize = 16
distLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
distLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
distLabel.Visible = false
distLabel.Parent = gui

local function hideArrow()
    arrow.Visible = false
    distLabel.Visible = false
end

local arrowConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not flags.Players then return hideArrow() end

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local theirs = currentBeast and currentBeast ~= lp and currentBeast.Character
        and currentBeast.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (cam and theirs) then return hideArrow() end

    -- distance in studs (from you; falls back to the camera)
    local myRoot = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local from = myRoot and myRoot.Position or cam.CFrame.Position
    local studs = math.floor((theirs.Position - from).Magnitude + 0.5)

    local viewport = cam.ViewportSize
    local sp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(theirs.Position)
    local inFront = sp.Z > 0

    -- Beast is on screen: no arrow needed
    if inFront and sp.X > ARROW_MARGIN and sp.X < viewport.X - ARROW_MARGIN
        and sp.Y > ARROW_MARGIN and sp.Y < viewport.Y - ARROW_MARGIN then
        return hideArrow()
    end

    local center = viewport / 2
    local dir = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center
    if not inFront then dir = -dir end
    if dir.Magnitude < 1 then dir = Vector2.new(0, 1) end
    dir = dir.Unit

    local tx = dir.X ~= 0 and (center.X - ARROW_MARGIN) / math.abs(dir.X) or math.huge
    local ty = dir.Y ~= 0 and (center.Y - ARROW_MARGIN) / math.abs(dir.Y) or math.huge
    local pos = center + dir * math.min(tx, ty)

    arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y)
    arrow.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dir.X, -dir.Y))
    arrow.Visible = true

    distLabel.Text = studs .. " studs"
    -- sit just behind the arrow's tail, clear of the text box edges
    local gap = 26 + math.abs(dir.X) * (distLabel.TextBounds.X / 2) + math.abs(dir.Y) * 9
    local lpos = pos - dir * gap
    distLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lpos.X, lpos.Y)
    distLabel.Visible = true
end)

local CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 229, 255)
local PINK = Color3.fromRGB(255, 46, 136)

local crawling = false
local crawlTrack, savedHip, savedSpeed, crawlConn
local noclipConn, noclipParts = nil, {} -- noclip only while crawling
local crawlBtn, crawlGrad, crawlStroke, crawlStrokeGrad, crawlLabel, crawlDot, crawlScale, crawlDragConn
local crawlDragged = false
local crawlLocked = false
local crawlPos = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0.6, 0) -- remembered between on/off

local function styleCrawlButton()
    if not crawlBtn then return end
    if crawling then
        crawlGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120), Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 90))
        crawlStrokeGrad.Enabled = false
        crawlStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(210, 255, 225)
        crawlLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 24, 12)
        crawlDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 24, 12)
    else
        crawlGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 44), Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 22))
        crawlStrokeGrad.Enabled = true
        crawlStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        crawlLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)
        crawlDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)
    end
end

local function findCrawlAnimation()
    for _, root in ipairs({ReplicatedStorage, lp.Character, lp, game:GetService("StarterPlayer")}) do
        for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Animation") and d.AnimationId ~= ""
                and d.Name:lower():find("crawl", 1, true) then
                return d
            end
        end
    end
end

local function stopCrawl()
    if crawlConn then crawlConn:Disconnect() crawlConn = nil end
    if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect() noclipConn = nil end
    for part in pairs(noclipParts) do
        if part.Parent then part.CanCollide = true end
    end
    noclipParts = {}
    if crawlTrack then
        pcall(function() crawlTrack:Stop() end)
        crawlTrack = nil
    end
    local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and savedHip then hum.HipHeight = savedHip end
    if hum and savedSpeed then hum.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed end
    savedHip, savedSpeed, crawling = nil, nil, false
    styleCrawlButton()
end

local function startCrawl()
    local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

    local anim = findCrawlAnimation()
    if not anim then
        return notify("Crawl", "No crawl animation found in this game.", 5)
    end

    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", hum)
    local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
    if not ok or not track then
        return notify("Crawl", "Couldn't load the crawl animation.", 5)
    end

    track.Looped = true
    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    track:Play()
    crawlTrack = track

    savedHip, savedSpeed = hum.HipHeight, hum.WalkSpeed
    hum.WalkSpeed = CRAWL_SPEED

    -- Keep the body pulled down to the floor (R6 and R15)
    crawlConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local c = lp.Character
        local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not h or not root or h.Health <= 0 then return end

        if h.WalkSpeed ~= CRAWL_SPEED then h.WalkSpeed = CRAWL_SPEED end

        -- sync the animation to how fast you're actually moving
        if crawlTrack then
            local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local moving = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
            crawlTrack:AdjustSpeed(moving > 0.5 and math.clamp(moving / CRAWL_ANIM_REF_SPEED, 0.3, 2) or 0)
        end
        if h.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then return end

        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c}
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), params)
        if not hit then return end

        local err = CRAWL_HEIGHT - (root.Position.Y - hit.Position.Y)
        if math.abs(err) > 0.05 then
            h.HipHeight = math.clamp(h.HipHeight + err * 0.3, -8, math.max(savedHip or 0, 2))
        end
    end)

    -- Noclip while crawling so you can fit through vents
    noclipParts = {}
    noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        local c = lp.Character
        if not c then return end
        for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.CanCollide then
                noclipParts[d] = true
                d.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end)

    crawling = true
    styleCrawlButton()
    hum.Died:Once(stopCrawl)
end

local function createCrawlButton()
    if crawlBtn then return end

    -- Invisible hit area (takes the taps / drags)
    crawlBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    crawlBtn.Name = "CrawlButton"
    crawlBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 46)

    crawlScale = Instance.new("UIScale", crawlBtn)

    bg.Parent = crawlBtn
    Instance.new("UICorner", bg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    crawlGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", bg)
    crawlGrad.Rotation = 90

    crawlStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", bg)
    crawlStroke.Thickness = 2.5
    crawlStrokeGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", crawlStroke)
    crawlStrokeGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(CYAN, PINK)

    crawlDot = Instance.new("Frame")
    crawlDot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
    crawlDot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
    crawlDot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0.5, 0)
    crawlDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    crawlDot.Parent = bg
    Instance.new("UICorner", crawlDot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    crawlLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    crawlLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 1, 0)
    crawlLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 0)
    crawlLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    crawlLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    crawlLabel.TextSize = 17
    crawlLabel.Text = "CRAWL"
    crawlLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    crawlLabel.Parent = bg

    styleCrawlButton()

    crawlBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
        if crawlDragged then
            crawlDragged = false -- that was a drag, not a tap
            return
        end
        if stat(lp, "IsBeast") ~= true then
            return notify("Beast Crawl", "Wait till you're the Beast!", 4)
        end
        if not crawlLocked then
            return notify("Beast Crawl", "Lock crawl button before using crawl!", 4)
        end
        if crawling then stopCrawl() else startCrawl() end
    end)

    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    crawlBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            crawlScale.Scale = 0.94 -- press effect
            crawlDragged = false
            if not crawlLocked then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = crawlBtn.Position
            end
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                    if crawlScale then crawlScale.Scale = 1 end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    crawlDragConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and not crawlLocked and crawlBtn
            and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            if d.Magnitude > 6 then crawlDragged = true end
            if crawlDragged then
                crawlPos = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
                crawlBtn.Position = crawlPos
            end
        end
    end)
end

    stopCrawl()
    if crawlDragConn then crawlDragConn:Disconnect() crawlDragConn = nil end
    if crawlBtn then

        crawlBtn = nil

    crawlDragged = false

--[[
	PORTAL (primera persona) - MÓVIL
	Colócalo como LocalScript en: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

	- Fuerza la primera persona.
	- Muestra la pistola de portales y la vida (HEALTH) como en el videojuego.
	- Los portales se crean en la superficie a la que apuntas (pared, suelo o techo).
	  Si no apuntas a nada, usa la superficie más cercana a ti.
	- Conserva el impulso: si caes por un portal del suelo, sales con esa velocidad.
	- Los botones están junto al botón de saltar.
	- Solo tú los ves y usas (LocalScript).

	local p = RaycastParams.new()

local function camFlat()
	local l = camera.CFrame.LookVector

		-0.75 + math.abs(math.cos(t * 6)) * 0.04 * bob, -1.4 + recoil * 0.35)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CREAR PORTALES
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function buildPortal(key, cf)
	if portals[key] then portals[key].model:Destroy() end

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Portal" .. key
	model.Parent = fx
	local color = COLORS[key]

	local function makeCylinder(fullSize, c, transparency)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		p.Size = Vector3.new(fullSize.X, 0.1, 0.1)
		p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		p.Color = c
		p.Transparency = transparency
		p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
		p.CFrame = cf * A(0, math.pi / 2, 0) -- el eje del cilindro mira hacia la normal de la superficie
		p.Parent = model
		TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = fullSize }):Play()

	end

	makeCylinder(Vector3.new(0.2, H + 0.8, W + 0.8), color, 0.05) -- aro brillante
	local disc = makeCylinder(Vector3.new(0.35, H, W), color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.55), 0.35)

	e.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1)
	e.Rate = 45

end

-- Marco del portal sobre una superficie (pared, suelo o techo)
local function surfaceFrame(pos, normal)
	pos = pos + normal * 0.06
	local up = Vector3.yAxis
	if math.abs(normal.Y) > 0.7 then
		up = camFlat() -- en suelo/techo el eje largo del portal sigue tu mirada, como en Portal
	else
		local g = workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -100, 0), castParams())
		if g and pos.Y - H / 2 < g.Position.Y then
			pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, g.Position.Y + H / 2 + 0.1, pos.Z)
		end
	end
	return CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + normal, up)
end

-- Superficie a la que apuntas; si no hay, la más cercana a ti
local function findSurface()
	local params = castParams()
	local vp = camera.ViewportSize / 2
	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(vp.X, vp.Y)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 250, params)
	if hit then return hit.Position, hit.Normal end

	local best
	for _, d in { Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, -Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.zAxis } do
		local h = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, d * 60, params)
		if h and (not best or h.Distance < best.Distance) then best = h end
	end
	if best then return best.Position, best.Normal end
end

local function shootBall(from, to, color, onHit)
	local b = Instance.new("Part")
	b.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	b.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
	b.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	b.Color = color
	b.Anchored, b.CanCollide, b.CanTouch, b.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
	b.Position = from
	b.Parent = fx
	local dur = math.clamp((to - from).Magnitude / 250, 0.05, 0.4)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Position = to })
	tw.Completed:Connect(function()
		b:Destroy()
		onHit()
	end)
	tw:Play()
end

local function fire(key)
	if not root or not root.Parent then return end
	local pos, normal = findSurface()
	if not pos then
		say("No hay ninguna superficie cerca")
		return
	end
	tipColor = COLORS[key]
	recoil = 1
	local cf = surfaceFrame(pos, normal)
	shootBall(tip.Position, pos, COLORS[key], function() buildPortal(key, cf) end)
end

local function clearPortals()
	for key, data in portals do
		data.model:Destroy()
		portals[key] = nil
	end
	refreshCross()
	say("Portales borrados")
end

btnA.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() fire("A") end)
btnB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() fire("B") end)
btnClear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(clearPortals)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TELETRANSPORTE (detección local: solo tú puedes entrar)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local lastTp, armed = 0, true

-- ¿Está tu personaje dentro de la zona de entrada del portal?
local function inside(data)
	local rel = data.cf:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
	if (rel.X / (W / 2)) ^ 2 + (rel.Y / (H / 2)) ^ 2 > 1 then return false end
	local d = -rel.Z -- distancia hacia fuera de la superficie
	local n = data.cf.LookVector
	if math.abs(n.Y) > 0.7 then
		if n.Y > 0 then return d < 4.3 and d > -1.5 end -- suelo: pisarlo
		return d < 3.3 and d > -1.5 -- techo: saltar hacia él
	end
	return math.abs(d) < 1.3 -- pared
end

local function teleport(from, to)
	lastTp = os.clock()
	local nOut = to.cf.LookVector

	-- Velocidad: del portal de entrada al de salida (giro de 180°)
	local vl = from.cf:VectorToObjectSpace(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
	vl = Vector3.new(-vl.X, vl.Y, -vl.Z)
	local vOut = to.cf:VectorToWorldSpace(vl)
	local minOut = (math.abs(nOut.Y) > 0.7) and 22 or 14
	local outSpeed = vOut:Dot(nOut)
	if outSpeed < minOut then vOut += nOut * (minOut - outSpeed) end

	-- Posición de salida
	local pos
	if math.abs(nOut.Y) > 0.7 then
		pos = to.cf.Position + nOut * 3.4
	else
		local flatOut = Vector3.new(nOut.X, 0, nOut.Z).Unit
		pos = to.cf.Position + flatOut * 2.4
		pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, to.cf.Position.Y - H / 2 + 3.2, pos.Z)
	end

	-- Giro de la cámara (para que mires hacia fuera del portal de salida)
	local rotMap = to.cf.Rotation * A(0, math.pi, 0) * from.cf.Rotation:Inverse()
	local newLook = rotMap * camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local camHeight = camera.CFrame.Position.Y - root.Position.Y

	local flat = Vector3.new(newLook.X, 0, newLook.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then flat = camFlat() end
	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + flat.Unit)
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vOut
	root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

	local camPos = pos + Vector3.new(0, camHeight, 0)
	pcall(function() camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, camPos + newLook) end)
	flash()
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not root or not root.Parent then return end

	local hitKey
	for key, data in portals do
		if inside(data) then
			hitKey = key
			break
		end
	end
	if not hitKey then
		armed = true -- te has alejado: vuelve a activarse
		return
	end
	if not armed or os.clock() - lastTp < 0.4 then return end

	local other = portals[hitKey == "A" and "B" or "A"]
	if other then
		armed = false
		teleport(portals[hitKey], other)
	end
end)
